tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Forget everything you thought you knew about kaiju flicks; this isn't just a monster movie, it's a gut-wrenching post-war drama where humanity's resilience is tested by a force more devastating than any bomb. Prepare for a spectacle that's as emotionally resonant as it is terrifyingly grand.

releases.title: Model Citizen
releases.take: When your memories vanish and everyone's watching, maybe that 'farm' isn't just for growing potatoes.

releases.title: Resident Evil
releases.take: Turns out 'medical courier' is just a fancy title for 'future zombie bait' in this chaotic night of survival.

releases.title: Heart of the Beast
releases.take: Man's best friend meets nature's worst intentions in an Alaskan survival tale that'll make you appreciate your couch.

critic.title: Ebenezer
critic.blurb: For those craving a slow-burn psychological thriller, 'Model Citizen' offers a chilling descent into forgotten memories and paranoid suspicion. It’s a masterclass in unsettling tension, proving that sometimes the scariest monsters are the ones you can't remember.
